episodes.synopsis: A strange disease is linked to a mysterious hole that leads to an underground world: the Asylum. "Sleepers" come to this world to fight strange monsters and retrieve unknown resources. Now, a young man who dreams of being a hero has arrived at the Asylum.
episodes.title: take 01

episodes.synopsis: As Shigure begins to settle into his new life as a Sleeper, he begins to wonder what he is good at and what he can accomplish at the Asylum.
episodes.title: take 02

episodes.synopsis: Larry goes on a dangerous and illegal mission deep in the Asylum and forces Shigure to go with him.
episodes.title: take 03

episodes.synopsis: Shigure delves into XO Leslie's past when a mysterious assailant suddenly ambushes him.
episodes.title: take 04

episodes.synopsis: Shigure is always embarrassed around Kobato and the rest of the team thinks he might have a crush on her. They hatch a plan to bring them together, but...
episodes.title: take 05

episodes.synopsis: The day of the plan has arrived and the team heads towards the Asylum. But when Hayden shows up during the mission, things go terribly wrong.
episodes.title: take 06

episodes.synopsis: With Leslie's death, the team is forced to find its way alone. And Shigure starts to have doubts about his mission...
episodes.title: take 07

episodes.synopsis: With strong pressure from the command hierarchy, Vera decides to lead a mission to the Asylum on her own.
episodes.title: take 08

episodes.synopsis: Vera is trapped in a time loop as she tries to complete her assassination mission. She reflects on the best way to make the mission successful.
episodes.title: take 09

episodes.synopsis: Vera drives Shigure away from the platoon, but he's not ready to leave the Asylum... yet.
episodes.title: Re:take

episodes.synopsis: Now trapped in a time loop, Shigure struggles to unravel the mystery behind EL-Cee and Iceman's plans.
episodes.title: Revolution

episodes.synopsis: Shigure travels through time once more to save Vera and stop Iceman from destroying the world.
episodes.title: Resolution
